Here is the polished version with improved clarity, tone, and structure:

---

**Subject: Re: Your Subscription Cancellation & Duplicate Charge – ACCT-2025-8842**

Dear [Customer Name],

Thank you for contacting us. I sincerely apologize for the duplicate charge and for the frustration caused by our delayed responses. Neither is acceptable, and I want to resolve this for you right away.

**What I am doing now:**

- Reviewing your account (ACCT-2025-8842) as a priority case
- Opening a formal investigation into the duplicate charge
- Escalating your refund request directly to our billing team

**What you can expect:**

- A **full refund** for the duplicate charge processed within **3–5 business days**
- Written confirmation of your cancellation sent to your email address within **24 hours**

I also want to address the lack of response to your previous emails directly. Three unanswered messages is a serious failure on our part, and I am flagging this internally to prevent it from happening again.

As a gesture of goodwill for the inconvenience caused, [**insert applicable offer, e.g., a one-month service credit**].

Please reply to this email or contact me directly at **[direct contact information]** if you have any questions or concerns. I will personally follow up with you once the refund has been confirmed.

Sincerely,
**[Your Name]**
Customer Support Team

---

**Implementation notes:**
- Verify the refund timeline aligns with your current billing policy before sending
- Replace all bracketed placeholders with accurate information
- Confirm any goodwill offer with your manager before including it
- Keep a record of this case for internal follow-up on the response delay issue
